agent-document-authoring.trigger: Creating/reviewing an agent-facing guide, instruction pointer or durable procedure.
agent-document-authoring.exclude: Stylistic compression that removes behavior or a second native skill/router system.

api-and-interface-design.trigger: A new or changed API/module boundary, inconsistent errors or a retryable state-changing operation.
api-and-interface-design.exclude: Pure private renaming or a request only to format code.

architecture-survey.trigger: A named architecture pain point or bounded request to find maintainability/testability friction.
architecture-survey.exclude: A routine feature fix, arbitrary whole-repo scan, or repeated search for findings after no worthwhile candidate.

article-shaping.trigger: An explicit writing request with existing raw material ready to be shaped.
article-shaping.exclude: Open fragment exploration, editing raw input without permission or publishing finished copy.

brainstorming.trigger: Explore possible directions for an uncertain goal, creative idea, research topic or everyday problem, including a build request whose direction the user says is unclear and has not delegated.
brainstorming.exclude: Accepted specifications, settled alternatives needing assessment, missing requirements alone, delegated choices, or confusion about running or understanding something already specified.

browser-testing-with-devtools.trigger: Browser-rendered behavior, console/network failure, layout/a11y regression or performance trace investigation.
browser-testing-with-devtools.exclude: Backend-only changes with no browser surface.

ci-cd-and-automation.trigger: CI/build/test pipeline configuration, automated checks, slow/flaky CI or deployment-strategy preparation.
ci-cd-and-automation.exclude: A request to manually deploy without an accepted verification contract.

code-review.trigger: Review PR, branch, WIP/untracked changes, pasted diff or completed feature.
code-review.exclude: Conceptual question with no change or unrequested cosmetic nit hunt.

code-simplification.trigger: Working green code with observed nesting, duplication, unclear names or a flagged complexity problem.
code-simplification.exclude: A failing test needing a behavioral fix, speculative cleanup or a rewrite whose seam is not accepted.

constraint-driven-development.trigger: Missing or changing quality contract, weakened thresholds, skips/suppressions or requested quality gates.
constraint-driven-development.exclude: An established unchanged contract that only needs to be followed, or a throwaway nonbehavioral edit.

context-engineering.trigger: Session restart, degraded context, task switch or a large evidence set needing a focused handoff.
context-engineering.exclude: A tiny self-contained request already supplied with all required context.

debugging.trigger: Tests/build fail, runtime output is wrong, a regression slows down or a bug is reported.
debugging.exclude: Healthy code explanation or speculative diagnosis without an observed issue.

decision-interview.trigger: An ambiguous ask, explicit interview request, or consequential choice with missing intent, including a known direction whose material user-owned requirement is open.
decision-interview.exclude: A clear accepted ticket, informational question, simple mechanical edit, or an open product direction that brainstorming should explore first.

decision-map.trigger: A destination is clear but several consequential questions cannot be resolved in one context.
decision-map.exclude: A small settled feature, routine task list or a second execution plan.

deep-module-design.trigger: A known module interface is hard to use, hard to verify or spreads changes across callers.
deep-module-design.exclude: A request for a whole-codebase survey or speculative abstraction without observed friction.

delegation.trigger: Bounded independent tasks or materially useful independent review.
delegation.exclude: Related unknown failures, shared write state, missing authority/tool or cheaper inline work.

delivery.trigger: Implementation/checks ready for handoff or material blocker needs explanation.
delivery.exclude: Still-missing acceptance that can safely be completed.

deprecation-and-migration.trigger: Retiring/replacing APIs, legacy ownership decisions or schema changes with active consumers.
deprecation-and-migration.exclude: Renaming an unused private local variable with no consumer or data migration.

design-prototype.trigger: A design question cannot be answered reliably in conversation alone.
design-prototype.exclude: An already settled implementation ticket, full-app sales demo, or a production feature disguised as throwaway work.

documentation-and-adrs.trigger: A consequential design decision, changed public interface, repeated onboarding gap or prose clarification.
documentation-and-adrs.exclude: Comments that merely narrate obvious code or a disposable spike.

domain-modeling.trigger: Overloaded domain terms, contradictory code/user vocabulary, or a meaningful architecture decision.
domain-modeling.exclude: Merely reading existing glossary terms or adding generic programming definitions.

doubt-driven-development.trigger: Unverified invariant, cross-boundary design, high-stakes or unfamiliar nontrivial artifact.
doubt-driven-development.exclude: Mechanical rename/format, pure source summary, or a clear instruction with obvious correctness.

environment-retrospective.trigger: Established failure causes and an explicit prevention retrospective; unknown causes go to session-diagnostics first.
environment-retrospective.exclude: Unexplained failures needing diagnosis, a trivial task, or unrelated global instruction rewrites.

exercise-scaffolding.trigger: An explicit exercise/course-section scaffolding or renumbering request.
exercise-scaffolding.exclude: Creating unsolicited course material or installing a proprietary linter as a prerequisite.

frontend-ui-engineering.trigger: User-facing component/page/layout/state change or accessibility defect.
frontend-ui-engineering.exclude: Pure backend or an attempt to override an explicitly chosen UI methodology.

git-isolation.trigger: Implementation needs isolation/branch-specific edits or resumed workspace reconciliation.
git-isolation.exclude: Read-only explanation or suitable existing authorized checkout.

git-operation-guard.trigger: An operation would publish, discard, rewrite or stage repository state, or an optional guard is explicitly requested.
git-operation-guard.exclude: Treating an upstream regex hook as a complete security control or installing global hooks automatically.

git-workflow-and-versioning.trigger: Change grouping, dirty-tree hygiene, version/changelog decision or support for accepted Git isolation.
git-workflow-and-versioning.exclude: Automatic branch creation, destructive reset or publishing without authority.

handoff.trigger: Work moves to another host/directory/person or requires an explicit portable continuation.
handoff.exclude: Routine continuation in the same context with enough room, or duplicating the existing Andino checkpoint.

human-procedure.trigger: A required step needs human dashboard access, secret entry or another action the agent cannot perform.
human-procedure.exclude: A task the agent can already safely execute or an unrequested setup wizard.

idea-refine.trigger: Rough idea needs distinct options, value/feasibility trade-offs or assumption testing.
idea-refine.exclude: Accepted scope already has a direction/spec, or intent is so missing that decision-interview must clarify it first.

implementation.trigger: A concrete accepted specification or ready task with implementation authorization.
implementation.exclude: Unresolved material product decisions, research-only requests or permission-denied live changes.

incremental-implementation.trigger: Multi-file accepted feature/change or the next dependency-ready implementation task.
incremental-implementation.exclude: Tiny isolated edit, unclear scope requiring decision/specification, or permission to skip failed gates.

issue-triage.trigger: A maintainer requests evaluation of incoming issues or opted-in external PRs.
issue-triage.exclude: Already accepted implementation tasks, self-generated tickets needing no new triage, or unauthorized bulk tracker changes.

learning-workspace.trigger: An explicit request for learning across sessions or a structured lesson tied to a concrete mission.
learning-workspace.exclude: A one-off factual answer or an assumption the user wants recurring lessons/automation.

method-authoring.trigger: Create/change method or recurring observed procedural failure needs guidance.
method-authoring.exclude: One-off note, mechanically enforceable rule or imagined problem.

observability-and-instrumentation.trigger: New production I/O, endpoint/job/retry/queue, missing incident evidence or alert/runbook design.
observability-and-instrumentation.exclude: Diagnosing one current failure only (debugging owns that) or unmeasured performance tuning.

performance-optimization.trigger: Measured slowness, budget regression, slow query/pool/cache issue or provided performance artifacts.
performance-optimization.exclude: Speculative memoization/index/cache work without evidence of a bottleneck.

plain-language-repitch.trigger: The user says the last explanation did not land or asks what a technical message means.
plain-language-repitch.exclude: A new research/implementation task or an opportunity to change project files.

plan-execution.trigger: Accepted plan ready or interrupted execution resumes.
plan-execution.exclude: Unresolved product intent or unapproved redesign.

planning.trigger: Accepted multi-step work lacks exact interfaces, dependency order or verification.
planning.exclude: Simple targeted edit or already complete accepted graph ready to execute.

pr-description.trigger: Writing or updating a PR description for a concrete diff.
pr-description.exclude: Creating/publishing a PR without authority or triaging review comments.

pre-commit-setup.trigger: An explicit request for commit-time formatting/checks or an evidenced missing guardrail.
pre-commit-setup.exclude: Committing work, global installation or running staged-file mutations on the user's index without authority.

primary-source-research.trigger: A concrete technical/factual question needs documentation or source investigation.
primary-source-research.exclude: An unresolved user preference, uncited speculative answer, or duplicate research with unchanged valid evidence.

project-configuration.trigger: A project needs an explicit tracker mapping, domain-doc convention or triage vocabulary.
project-configuration.exclude: Ordinary Andino use, mandatory setup before every engineering task or global host configuration.

security-and-hardening.trigger: External input/auth/data/URL/filesystem/dependency/LLM trust boundary or requested security audit.
security-and-hardening.exclude: A purely mechanical private edit with no relevant boundary; speculative checklist expansion outside scope.

session-diagnostics.trigger: User identifies repeated work, ignored plan, unexpected tools, cost or verification failure in a session.
session-diagnostics.exclude: Unscoped sweep of all history or directly reproducible code bug.

shipping-and-launch.trigger: Requested production/release readiness, staged rollout, launch monitoring or rollback planning.
shipping-and-launch.exclude: A local-only change with no release request, or bypassing explicit publication approval.

source-driven-development.trigger: Framework/API/library-specific implementation fact whose correctness depends on version.
source-driven-development.exclude: Pure stable logic, mechanical rename or mandatory fetching/installing documentation at runtime.

specification.trigger: A significant accepted request lacks a buildable specification or its scope has materially changed.
specification.exclude: An existing current approved spec, a small unambiguous edit or a request to explore intent before it is known.

stakeholder-questionnaire.trigger: Progress depends on facts/decisions held by a named other person.
stakeholder-questionnaire.exclude: The user can answer directly, environmental facts the agent can inspect, or an instruction to send messages without authority.

task-decomposition.trigger: An accepted multi-step build needs bounded task deliverables and dependencies.
task-decomposition.exclude: A change already fits one clear slice or an attempt to create another mandatory plan.

tdd.trigger: A feature, bug fix or behavior change needs a regression guard, including pasted code.
tdd.exclude: Pure prose/static content or reversible configuration without behavioral impact.

test-fixture-migration.trigger: An explicit TypeScript test-fixture assertion problem or requested shoehorn migration.
test-fixture-migration.exclude: Production code, runtime validation, or blanket replacement of every type assertion.

typescript-boundary-enforcement.trigger: An explicitly accepted TypeScript deep-package layout needs deterministic import enforcement.
typescript-boundary-enforcement.exclude: Universal folder restructuring or a conceptual interface discussion without a chosen layout.

verification.trigger: About to report fixed/passing/complete or accept worker output.
verification.exclude: No change/claim needing proof; do not rerun unchanged checks ritualistically.

workflow-specification.trigger: An explicit request to design a repeatable workflow or identify a delegable recurring pattern.
workflow-specification.exclude: Starting a monitor/schedule, replacing Andino lifecycle or forcing AI/checkpoints into every activity.

workflow-advisor.trigger: Explicit advice on choosing or comparing workflows, skills or method combinations.
workflow-advisor.exclude: Normal automatic routing, accepted implementation, or automatic execution of recommendations.

writing-fragments.trigger: An explicit exploratory writing session seeking material rather than a finished argument.
writing-fragments.exclude: A fixed-pile article-shaping task or permission to invent personal anecdotes.

focus.purpose: Default communication on every Andino invocation

natural-writing.purpose: Prose quality for requested writing artifacts

threejs-skills.purpose: On-demand Three.js and NixieFX domain specialists

impeccable.purpose: UI critique, polish and anti-slop detection
